description:
Turn a page design into finished HTML.

Three targets, and the difference is not cosmetic:
- "document" — a complete page for hosting anywhere. Stylesheet + meta tags.
- "widget"   — a scoped fragment to drop inside a native funnel page. Prefixed
               so it cannot collide with the host page's CSS.
- "blog"     — a fragment for a CRM blog post. INLINE styles only, no script,
               because a blog body is sanitised HTML. Verified against a live
               location: it survives byte for byte.

Every target renders the real copy into the HTML. Personalisation is layered on
top and never a dependency, so the page still reads correctly to a crawler or an
AI bot with JavaScript disabled.

Read-only — this creates nothing in anyone's account.
